Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized x25.01.17 port workspace. Creature phase 1 adds manually spawned fox and rabbit using native SCNET four-legged animation and AI. Crop phase adds clean-room corn (seed, staged growth, harvest ear/fodder), bamboo (vertical segment growth, chop harvest, solid building block) and flax (staged growth, harvest fiber/seed), each backed by a project-generated 512x512 RGBA atlas. Android/7723 verification is required.
